dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.description: You attempt to dodge an incoming attack, avoiding it entirely if successful.

uncanny dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny dodge.description: You use your reaction to halve the damage from an attack that hits you, provided you can see the attacker.

block.name: Block
block.description: You brace yourself to block an incoming attack, reducing the damage taken by half.

heavy block.name: Heavy Block
heavy block.description: You brace yourself to block an incoming attack, reducing the damage taken by three-quarters.

counter-clash.name: Counter Clash
counter-clash.description: You attempt to counter an attack, making an immediate attack against the attacker.
